work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Motu proprio LXVI assigns the Roman seminary a 60-scudi pension on the Grottaferrata abbey and transfers the older 150-scudi charge to the Tusculum seminary; full dispositive clauses, derogations and dating clause survive. Issuer evidence: GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF14910–14910; the source dating clause at LF15124–15127 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die vigesima sexta ianuar. millesimo octingentesimo quadragesimo primo, pontifica- tus Nostri anno decimo primo. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
